texts.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上快速的科技进展催生了工业化的时代。交通方式的跃进式发展将此前星球上相对孤立的区域连成一片，创造了环球贸易和思想交流的机遇。

然而，资源的危机正在悄悄酝酿。如果其他星球上的历史也会重演的话，这里的人们很快就会陷入战争。
texts.en:
Rapid technological advances on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] are ushering in an age of industrialization. Breakthroughs in transportation have linked previously disconnected areas of the world, creating opportunity for global trade and the sharing of ideas.

However, tensions over resources are already brewing. If the history of other worlds is any guide, the populace could soon find themselves at war.

label.zh: 或许我们可以伸出援手，帮助他们赈济灾民……
label.en: Perhaps we could help them avert a catastrophe...

label.zh: 无论是哪种方法，他们总要学会。
label.en: They will learn, one way or another.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们冒着计算过的风险，向[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的星球领袖透露了自己的身份。我们毫不含糊地建议当地政府结束他们的冲突，警告说战争的后果很可能是灾难性的。许多人试探性地听着。其他人则认为任何关于“外星使者”的谈话都是一个骗局。
texts.en: Taking a calculated risk, we revealed ourselves to world leaders of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]. In no uncertain terms, we advised the local governments to end their conflict, warning that the consequences of war could well be catastrophic. Many listened tentatively. Others dismissed any talk of 'alien emissaries' as a hoax.

label.zh: 时间将证明他们是否听从了我们的警告。
label.en: Time will tell if they will heed our warning.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that planet appears here.

texts.zh: [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的各领袖接受了我们的建议，放下了他们的武器。很难说这样的和平会持续多久，但至少现在，他们不太可能将自己从他们的行星表面抹除了。
texts.en: The leaders of [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have taken our advice and put down their weapons. It is impossible to say if the peace will last, but for now at least, they are unlikely to wipe themselves from the face of their planet.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of another planet appears here.

texts.zh:
我们的接入对[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]宛如火上浇油。他们的整个星球陷入了战争。然而，如果他们没能互相消灭的话，这种局势也许也有积极的一面：这颗行星上的科技进步成果卓绝。

也许，当战争的硝烟散去，他们就能妥善地把这些科技用到正道上。
texts.en:
Our intervention may have added fuel to the proverbial fire on [FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Their world is now at war. However, if they fail to eradicate one another, there may be an upside to the situation: the technological progress being made on the planet is remarkable.

Perhaps, when and if the smoke of battle clears, they will put some of this technology to good use.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of another planet appears here.

texts.zh:
我们决定任由[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的星球领袖自行发展，现在他们是自己命运的第一责任人了。不幸的是，好像他们正在走向战争。

据信是不可调和的差异导致了星球上不同的文化群体之间兵戎相见。紧随而来的冲突开启了他们的发展史上一段黑暗的篇章。
texts.en:
In choosing to leave the world leaders of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] to their own devices, they are now wholly responsible for their destiny. Unfortunately, it appears they are headed for war.

Supposedly irreconcilable differences have driven the planet's culture groups to take up arms against one another. The coming conflict represents a dark period in their development.

# 工业进步 / Industrial Advancement

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:2919-3191`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 100。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 100.
- 条件：蒸汽、工业或机器时代、以“样本采集”任务观测，被观测者不是和平主义或格式塔，且未禁用毁灭性前超光速事件；每个前超光速文明一次。
  Conditions: Steam, Industrial or Machine Age observed with Specimen Collection; the observed civilization is neither pacifist nor gestalt, and devastating pre-FTL events are not blocked; once per pre-FTL civilization.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1380「工业进步」：工业化带来全球贸易，也带来资源纷争。
  1380 "Industrial Advancement": industrialization brings global trade and resource tensions.
- “帮他们避免灾难”→ 100 天后 1385「灾难悬而未决」（我们向各国领袖现身警告）→ 再 100 天 50% 1395「灾难得到避免」/ 50% 1400「灾难」（战争爆发但科技飞跃）；或“他们会学到的”→ 100 天后 1390「不文明的战争」。
  "Help them avert a catastrophe" → 100 days later 1385 "Catastrophe Pending" (we reveal ourselves and warn their leaders) → another 100 days: 50% 1395 "Catastrophe Averted" / 50% 1400 "Catastrophe" (war, but rapid progress); or "they will learn" → 100 days later 1390 "Uncivil War".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 干预与不干预互斥；干预后 1395/1400 各 50%。
  Intervening and not intervening are exclusive; after intervening 1395/1400 are 50/50.
- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无额外的文明差异分支。
  No further empire-specific variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、选项、50/50 权重与两段 100 天延迟。
  Checked: trigger, options, 50/50 weights and both 100-day delays.
